title: Pong: Bounce the Ball
story: A ball moves along a line of width cells. When it would leave the screen it turns around.
goal: Write bounce(x, dx, width): move the ball by dx. If the new position is outside 0 to width-1, reverse dx and move the other way instead. Return (new_x, new_dx).
hints: Where would the ball go next? Is that square on the screen?
If not, flip dx first, then move again.
socratic: What should happen at x = 0 when dx is -1?
Compare your output with the goal. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: what did you learn from “Pong: Bounce the Ball”?
